moxfield_nolt_2430.text: Make the wishlist display match how the user created it by default. · Moxfield Feedback Sorry, we don t support your browser. Install a modern browser Make the wishlist display match how the user created it by default. Type Feature Update Subscribe to updates Upvote 7 Each user’s wishlist (moxfield.com/wishlist) contains specific card versions — foil or non-foil, different sets, etc. When you generate a share link and someone else opens it, if they are not logged in and haven’t disabled the “Collapse multiple printings into a single card” setting, part of the list is displayed incorrectly. Many cards are shown as the version that was added first, rather than the version you added later, and obviously, several different specific versions of the same card that you actually need get collapsed into a single one. This is extremely inconvenient and interferes with buying cards using a wishlist. I experienced this today when I shared my wishlist in my LGS chat, asking if anyone had these cards for sale. Despite a bolded note before the link saying, “Guys, please log in to the site and disable ‘Collapse multiple printings into a single card’ in the settings,” none of the people who replied did so. Either they didn’t bother or simply didn’t read the text and opened the link out of habit. As a result, everyone was very surprised to learn that I actually needed the foil version, since they saw the non-foil one in the list, and so on. It’s extremely awkward to ask someone to register or log in and then change account settings just to correctly understand which cards you need. This leads to a lot of wasted time. The same applies to decklists — it would be great if, by default, all cards were displayed exactly as intended. At least for non-logged-in users and for those who have customized their display settings in their account. I strongly ask you to fix at least the wishlist, because otherwise there’s little point to use it and having the ability to share it if it can be displayed incorrectly. Thank you. :) arkir4 8 months ago 2 Feedback Feedback Roadmap Board Kanban Sign in Make a suggestion

cardmarket_wants_create.text: Add Cards to Wants List | Cardmarket English home3 Help Add Cards to Wants List How to Add Cards From a Product Page If you quickly want to add a card to your wants list, click the button on the product page. The Wants Tab Every single has a wants tab that lets you add the card directly to an existing wants list. You can also access your wants lists from this page using the "New List" button. How to Add Cards from the Wants List Page Click View / Edit on the list you want. Click "Add a Wanted Card" in the top left. Type in the name of the card you re looking for. Set the filters you want for your card: Quantity Expansion Languages Min. Condition Signed Altered Foil Buy Price (info) Email Alarm Check "Email Alarm" to receive an email when a card matching your wanted card (including condition, language, etc.,) is listed. This feature will only send you an email the first time a card matching your criteria is listed, to avoid spamming your inbox. You can recheck the option if you miss the listing. Once you add a card, you can continue to look for and add more cards. Each time you add a card, a green information box will pop up and let you know the process was successful. Once you ve successfully added your cards, you can see the new cards in your wants list. send1 Share General Terms and Conditions About Us Privacy Policy Netiquette Help Jobs Manufacturers Accessibility Feedback External Links © Copyright 2026 Sammelkartenmarkt GmbH und Co.
